title: A catapult, not an underhand throw
description: The robot accelerates the cube into a long toss across the room, finding a different throwing motion from the expected demonstration.

title: Turn the tool. Change the scoop.
description: A regrasp from the left changes the tool’s reach, enabling a large scoop over the wall.

title: The tray becomes the tool
description: Instead of using the scoop, the robot lifts the source tray and pours its contents directly into the target.

title: Missed the grasp? Try again.
description: The program detects a failed grasp and retries while sorting a cluttered pile of colored cubes.

title: A gripper can be a sweeper
description: The agent leaves the sweeper aside and uses the gripper itself to move crumbs into the open drawer.

title: The windmill maneuver
description: A wide rotation of the hook creates an unexpected route for manipulating the target.

title: One ball at a time
description: A painstaking solution: carry the balls across the divider individually rather than making a large scoop.

title: When blocked, find a spare
description: The program uses an alternative block from the far table when the nearby retrieval route is obstructed.
